blocks.html: Leading property developer, Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC), will celebrate the grand opening of its 46th shopping mall – Robinsons Place Naga – on August 15 at 10:30 a.m. with the cast of the top rated TV Series “Wildflower” joining in the celebration to entertain the audiences with their incredible performances. Robinsons Malls Celebrity Endorser, Maja Salvador, will take center stage as she shows her dancing prowess to prove why she is dubbed as the Dancing Princess. She will also perform a song number together with two of the country’s most sought-after leading men, Joseph Marco and RK Bagatsing. The fun and excitement continues as 20 lucky fans will get to meet the stars up close and personal after the show. To join, simply like the official Robinsons Place Naga Facebook Page and comment your answer to these questions: “Who is joining Maja for the Grand Opening of #RobinsonsPlaceNaga on August 15?” and “Why is #RobinsonsPlaceNaga your new favorite mall?” The promo runs from August 3 to 14 so take out your gadgets and quickly comment your answer to win.

With the opening of Robinsons Place Naga, more surprises await the mall-goers as Kapamilya actress Erich Gonzales visits the mall on August 18 for a meet and greet session with her fans and perky teen boy band, Gimme 5, serenade the girls with their catchy and upbeat songs on August 19.
